metadata.question: Was there more green vegetation visible around Onemen Bay near Anadyr on August 9, 2025, than on September 11, 2025?

data.raw_code: The user asks: "Was there more green vegetation visible around Onemen Bay near Anadyr on August 9, 2025, than on September 11, 2025?" Key points: 1. Location: Onemen Bay near Anadyr, Russia. Coordinates: approximately 64.73°N, 177.51°E. 2. Dates: Two specific dates in 2025 (August 9 and September 11). Note: 2025 is in the future relative to current data availability (2024). We need to check if data exists. 3. Vegetation metric: Should use NDVI (Normalized Difference Vegetation Index) to measure green vegetation. 4. Comparison: Compare mean NDVI values between the two dates. Strategy: 1. Data collection: Use Sentinel-2 for high-resolution NDVI. Since dates are specific, we'll filter for ±15 days window to account for cloud cover. 2. Cloud masking: Important for accurate NDVI. Use QA60 band for Sentinel-2. 3. Validation: Check if images exist for both dates. If not, try fallback (Landsat 8/9). If still no data, output C1. 4. Processing: Calculate mean NDVI over a 1km buffer around the point. Check valid pixel count after masking. 5. Comparison: If August 9 NDVI > September 11 NDVI, answer "A: Yes", else "B: No". 6. Edge cases: Future dates may have no data → C1. Heavy cloud cover → C2. Invalid NDVI values → C3. Important considerations: - 2025 data may not be available yet. We should check collection size. - Use appropriate scale (1000m) to avoid timeout. - Print concise stats: image counts, valid pixels, mean NDVI. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const point = ee.Geometry.Point([177.51, 64.73]); // Onemen Bay near Anadyr const region = point.buffer(1000); // 1km buffer const date1 = '2025-08-09'; const date2 = '2025-09-11'; const window = 15; // days around target date // Function to get Sentinel-2 image for a target date function getS2Image(targetDate) { const start = ee.Date(targetDate).advance(-window, 'day'); const end = ee.Date(targetDate).advance(window, 'day'); let col = ee.ImageCollection('COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED') .filterBounds(region) .filterDate(start, end) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUDY_PIXEL_PERCENTAGE', 80)); // Cloud masking function function maskS2Clouds(image) { const qa = image.select('QA60'); const cloudBitMask = 1 << 10; const cirrusBitMask = 1 << 11; const mask = qa.bitwiseAnd(cloudBitMask).eq(0) .and(qa.bitwiseAnd(cirrusBitMask).eq(0)); return image.updateMask(mask); } col = col.map(maskS2Clouds); // Get image closest to target date const sorted = col.sort('system:time_start', false); const image = sorted.first(); return image; } // Function to calculate NDVI and stats function processImage(img, dateStr) { // Check if image exists const imgId = img.id(); const count = img.bandNames().length(); const hasBands = count.getInfo(); if (hasBands === 0) { return { ndvi: null, pixels: 0, date: dateStr, valid: false }; } // Calculate NDVI (B8: NIR, B4: Red) const ndvi = img.normalizedDifference(['B8', 'B4']).rename('NDVI'); // Get pixel count and mean const stats = ndvi.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.count().combine({ reducer2: ee.Reducer.mean(), sharedInputs: true }), geometry: region, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9, bestEffort: true }); const pixelCount = ee.Number(stats.get('NDVI_count')).getInfo(); const meanNdvi = ee.Number(stats.get('NDVI_mean')).getInfo(); return { ndvi: meanNdvi, pixels: pixelCount, date: dateStr, valid: pixelCount > 0 && meanNdvi !== null }; } // 2. Data Acquisition & Check console.log('Checking data availability...'); const img1 = getS2Image(date1); const img2 = getS2Image(date2); const result1 = processImage(img1, date1); const result2 = processImage(img2, date2); // Print stats console.log(`${date1}: NDVI=${result1.ndvi !== null ? result1.ndvi.toFixed(3) : 'No data'}, Valid pixels=${result1.pixels}`); console.log(`${date2}: NDVI=${result2.ndvi !== null ? result2.ndvi.toFixed(3) : 'No data'}, Valid pixels=${result2.pixels}`); // 3. Validation & Final Answer // Case C1: Empty Collection (no images) if (!result1.valid && result1.pixels === 0) { console.log('C1'); return; } if (!result2.valid && result2.pixels === 0) { console.log('C1'); return; } // Case C2: No Valid Pixels if (result1.pixels === 0 || result2.pixels === 0) { console.log('C2'); return; } // Case C3: Calculation Failure if (result1.ndvi === null || result2.ndvi === null || isNaN(result1.ndvi) || isNaN(result2.ndvi) || result1.ndvi < -1 || result1.ndvi > 1 || result2.ndvi < -1 || result2.ndvi > 1) { console.log('C3'); return; } // Valid comparison if (result1.ndvi > result2.ndvi) { console.log('A'); } else { console.log('B'); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
